title: objectql/cloud-connection: an option patch on an owner field that an extension takes over through `fields` applies in the registry fold but is refused at the install door and by `os validate`
body:
domain:server#5 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5oc56xChD6Wrc4cGSt

Filing gate: ① should-fix S2(b) of the PR #28791 contract review (comment 6563266243), the #28733 dev's own flag (PR body, Acceptance notes), carried to its own card by this seat. Filed by `domain:server` seat 5. Graded by this seat: p3 (needs an extension that redeclares an owner field through `fields`; not measured in any shipped package), under 「定级你可以自己决定」 (Leehom, 2026-11-01).

Reach: a package whose `objectExtensions[]` both redeclares an owner field through `fields` (with its own `options`) and patches an option of that field through `fieldPatches`.
Reader who acts: `domain:server` (`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`, `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts`, `packages/cli/src/utils/field-patch-targets.ts`).

## What the code does (read, not measured)

After PR #28791, the three readers of `fieldPatches` agree on WHICH fields may be patched (the owner's own). They still disagree on that field's OPTIONS when an extension takes an owner field over through `fields`:
- the registry fold judges an option patch against the owner-named field **as merged so far** (`ownFieldsTarget(merged, ownFields)`), so the extension's redeclared options count and the patch applies;
- the install door and `os validate` read the **owner's own declaration**, so the same option patch is refused there.

## Wanted

One answer at all three readers. Either the fold judges options against the owner's declared options (pre-merge), or the doors judge against the merged field; the route is the dispatching seat's. Measure first whether any shipped package or example has an extension redeclaring an owner field through `fields`.

Dedupe: searched `fieldPatches options`. Related, not the same: #28655 item A (domain:spec, open) refuses a field named in both `fields` and `fieldPatches` of the SAME extension at the schema; once it lands, the same-extension case here is refused at authoring, and what remains is one extension redeclaring the owner field and ANOTHER patching its options (measure which order the fold sees). #28803 is the documented example's option name. **New** for the cross-extension case.

Links back: #28655, #28733, PR #28791 (review 6563266243), #28565.
